sources.geometryDetail: full source snapshot, named feature selection

metadata.countMeaning: 83 existing RUS source features plus 2 selected UKR source features for existing Crimea display coverage; not an official present administrative count
metadata.membershipGeometry: Pinned input polygons before outline simplification; boundary touching is included; existing route segments are never joined
metadata.catalogPolicy: Geometry source records are not published catalog entries. UI intersects these URLs with its active catalog; membership grants no verification or permission.
metadata.centerMethod: Interior representative point of the largest polygon component
limitations: RUS uses the existing simplified overview source and cannot claim full-resolution coastal accuracy.
The exact intersection is relative to the supplied source polygons, not a field survey or current legal boundary.
Source shapeGroup and shapeISO values are preserved, including UKR attributes for Crimea and Sevastopol.
The unwrapped GeoJSON is a renderer display asset; it is not canonical RFC 7946 longitude interchange.
